name: telestra

scripts.generate: node scripts/generate-types.mjs && node scripts/generate-control-validators.mjs && node scripts/generate-go-control.mjs
scripts.contract:check: node scripts/generate-types.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-control-validators.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-go-control.mjs --check && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-contracts.ts
scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tests/browser/tsconfig.json && node scripts/check-format.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-japanese-comments.ts && go vet ./... && go run ./scripts/checkerrors
scripts.control:check: tsc -p apps/control/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/phase01/tsconfig.json && npm run control:test
scripts.check: python3 scripts/validate_package.py && npm run contract:check && npm run lint && npm run public:check && npm test && npm run test:go && npm run control:check
scripts.public:check: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-docs.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/audit-licenses.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/publication-scan.ts
scripts.browser:check: tsc -p tests/browser/tsconfig.json && npm run control:build && node scripts/test.mjs --browser

description: Cloudflare-firstの分散テレビ視聴・録画基盤。現在はローカルMockと制御契約を開発中。
